BUGGER.gloss: someone who engages in anal copulation
BUGGER.definition: Someone who engages in anal copulation (especially a male who engages in anal copulation with another male).

URGE.gloss: force or impel in an indicated direction
URGE.definition: Force or impel in an indicated direction.
URGE.example: I urged him to finish his studies.

BERG.gloss: a large mass of ice floating at sea
BERG.definition: A large mass of ice floating at sea; usually broken off of a polar glacier.

EGG.gloss: animal reproductive body consisting of an ovum or embryo together with nutritive and…
EGG.definition: Animal reproductive body consisting of an ovum or embryo together with nutritive and protective envelopes; especially the thin-shelled reproductive body laid by e.g. female birds.

BUG.gloss: general term for any insect or similar creeping or crawling invertebrate
BUG.definition: General term for any insect or similar creeping or crawling invertebrate.

RUG.gloss: floor covering consisting of a piece of thick heavy fabric
RUG.definition: Floor covering consisting of a piece of thick heavy fabric (usually with nap or pile).
